### Part I · Identification of beneficial owner

**B01 — Name of beneficial owner**

```text
MARICEL
BUENAFLOR
ESCALANTE
```

Put all three values in the same name field in the order shown.

**B02 — Country of citizenship**  
Philippines

**B03 — Permanent residence street address**

```text
Blk 418 Bedok North Avenue 2, #07-215, Singapore 460418
```

Copy the street and any apartment or unit number from the restored address into this field.

**B04 — City or town, state or province, and postal code**

```text
Blk 418 Bedok North Avenue 2, #07-215, Singapore 460418
```

Copy the city or town, any applicable state or province, and the postal code from the restored address into this field.

**B05 — Country**  
Singapore

**B06 — Mailing address**  
Leave all three blanks empty if your mailing address is the same. If it differs, each blank needs its corresponding value from your mailing address.

```text
NEEDS-YOU
NEEDS-YOU
NEEDS-YOU
```

**B07 — U.S. taxpayer identification number**  
Leave blank unless required. If required, enter your U.S. SSN or ITIN yourself.

```text
NEEDS-YOU
```

**B08 — Foreign tax identifying number**

```text
NEEDS-YOU
```

Enter your Singapore tax number directly on the form.

**B09 — FTIN not legally required**  
Leave unchecked.

**B10 — Reference number(s)**  
Leave blank unless the brokerage asks for a reference. If it does, enter the reference it specifies.

```text
NEEDS-YOU
```

**B11 — Date of birth**

```text
09 AUG 1991
```

Reformat the restored date by hand as MM-DD-YYYY.

### Part II · Claim of tax treaty benefits

**B12 — Treaty residence**  
Leave blank for this draft, which makes no treaty claim.

**B13 — Special rates and conditions**  
Leave all four blanks empty.

### Part III · Certification

**B14 — Capacity to sign**  
Leave unchecked when signing for yourself as the beneficial owner.

**B15 — Signature**

```text
NEEDS-YOU
```

Sign the form yourself.

**B15 — Date**

```text
NEEDS-YOU
```

Enter the date you sign in MM-DD-YYYY format.

**B16 — Printed name of signer**

```text
MARICEL
BUENAFLOR
ESCALANTE
```

Put all three values in the same printed-name field in the order shown.
